name: Permission Denied on Restore
description: A restore fails because the credentials issued to the backup service no longer have sufficient scope to read from the target bucket, following an unrelated access-policy change. Retries fail identically since the condition is not transient.
expectedFailureSignature: auth issues a token immediately after a policy update; storage rejects every subsequent read with ACCESS_DENIED (403); retries do not change the outcome because the token's scope, not its validity, is the problem.
